name: PDF Document Generator
description: Generate PDF reports, invoices, and certificates with full support for Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, and Russian using Playwright. Output saved to the workspace.
short_description: Create multilingual PDFs with charts and images.
store_description: Creates PDF documents from structured data using Playwright + Chromium. Handles any language (Arabic RTL, CJK, Cyrillic). Supports tables, images, and Chart.js visualizations. Always verifies the output file before reporting success.

examples.context: User provides monthly sales data as a table or CSV.
examples.expected_outcome: A PDF with a title, a table, and a bar chart saved as sales_report.pdf in the workspace.

examples.context: User provides invoice line items and a customer name.
examples.expected_outcome: A right-to-left PDF invoice with proper Arabic shaping and a totals table.
